mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.writer_id, m.name as writer_name, b.create_date, b.update_date FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.writer_id, m.name as writer_name, b.create_date, b.update_date FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.writer_id, m.name as writer_name, b.create_date, b.update_date FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.writer_id = m.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (title, content, writer_id, create_date, update_date) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writerId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, update_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
